assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium Korean website builder use-case page, editorial photography. Create a single high-quality wide 3:2 landscape photograph of a small business owner handing a beautifully minimal forest-green and warm-white business card to a potential client across a contemporary design studio desk. Close focus on natural human hands and the crisp card, softly blurred Korean interior studio with wood samples, a clean laptop and daylight in background. The business card is the visual hero, centered, rich tactile paper. The card has only a small elegant abstract geometric mark, very subtle horizontal print-like lines, NO readable text, NO QR code, NO brand names, no overlay UI, no watermark. Candid commercial editorial aesthetic, soft directional afternoon daylight, deep forest green, white, natural timber, realistic anatomy, sophisticated and inviting. Reserve clean upper right area for a small website preview overlay added separately by code. Do not render a website mockup in foreground.
assets.processing: Resized to width 1440 and encoded to WebP with sharp; no compositing.
